local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local ToolHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ToolHelper"))
local AudioHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))
local RangedCombatClient = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("RangedCombatClient"))

local GunValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.GunValue
local PlayerValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.PlayerValue
local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local featureSwitch = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("玩法开关"):WaitForChild("新版移动端射击视角")
local _toolCP = CommonFunc:CreateConnectionProxy(script)

local idleTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(character,112057956553263)
local fireTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(character,82124648755414)
idleTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
idleTrack.Looped = true
fireTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action3
fireTrack.Looped = false

local v_dragItem:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(LocalPlayer,PlayerValue.dragItem)

local function getLegacyAimWorldPosition()
	if UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
		local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
		local uiInterface = playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("UIInterface")
		local mobileFrame = uiInterface and uiInterface:FindFirstChild("UIInteractiveMobile", true)
		local shiftLock = mobileFrame and mobileFrame:FindFirstChild("ShiftLock")
		if shiftLock and shiftLock:GetAttribute("ShiftLockActive") == true then
			local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params:AddToFilter(LocalPlayer.Character)
			params:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
			local result = workspace:Raycast(camera.CFrame.Position, camera.CFrame.LookVector * 1000, params)
			return result and result.Position or camera.CFrame.Position + camera.CFrame.LookVector * 1000
		end
	end
	return GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
end

ToolHelper.onEquipTool.Event:Connect(function(_,gun:Tool)
	if not gun:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gun) then return end
	RangedCombatClient.BindWeaponCrosshair(gun)
	idleTrack:Play()

	local configFolder = gun:WaitForChild("配置",5)
	if not configFolder then return end
	local gunItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(gun)
	if not gunItemLo then return end
	local bulletItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(tonumber(gunItemLo.param))
	if not bulletItemLo then return end
	local steamWeaponId = gunItemLo.id
	local isSteamWeapon = steamWeaponId == 614 or steamWeaponId == 615
	local shotRange = steamWeaponId == 615 and 300 or (steamWeaponId == 614 and 120 or 100)

	local c_shotCD:NumberValue = configFolder:WaitForChild("发射间隔")
	local v_reloading:BoolValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(gun,GunValue.reloading)
	local v_bulletAmount:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(gun,GunValue.bulletAmount)
	local FirePoint:Attachment? = gun:FindFirstChild("FirePoint",true)
	local nextFireTime = 0
	local holdingFire = false
	local heldContext = nil

	local function tryFireGun(inputContext)
		if not GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) or gun.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
		if v_bulletAmount.Value <= 0 then
			GameHelper.GunReloadC2S:FireServer()
			return
		end
		if v_reloading.Value then return end
		if isSteamWeapon and (LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("SteamHeatState") or "Normal") ~= "Normal" then return end
		local timeNow = workspace.DistributedGameTime
		if timeNow < nextFireTime then return end

		local shotContext
		if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
			shotContext = RangedCombatClient.BeginShot(inputContext)
			if not shotContext then return end
		end
		nextFireTime = timeNow + c_shotCD.Value

		local aimTarget:Vector3 = shotContext and shotContext.AimWorldPosition or getLegacyAimWorldPosition()
		local rayOrigin = FirePoint and FirePoint.WorldPosition or LocalPlayer.Character:GetPivot().Position
		local aimDirection = aimTarget - rayOrigin
		if aimDirection.Magnitude <= 0.001 then return end

		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params:AddToFilter(LocalPlayer.Character)
		params:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
		local result = workspace:Raycast(rayOrigin, aimDirection.Unit * shotRange, params)
		local hit:BasePart? = result and result.Instance or nil
		local endPos = result and result.Position or (rayOrigin + aimDirection.Unit * shotRange)
		local isNpc,npc = GameHelper:IsNPC(hit)
		local function playLocalShot(actualEndPosition:Vector3)
			task.spawn(function()
				if gun:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.RegularBulletStyle) then
					GameHelper:PlayRegularBulletStyle(gun,actualEndPosition,nil,isNpc == true)
				elseif gun:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.ShotGunBulletStyle) then
					GameHelper:PlayShotGunBulletStyle(gun,actualEndPosition,isNpc == true)
				end
			end)
			fireTrack:Play()
			GameHelper.onMyGunFire:Fire(hit,actualEndPosition)
			if isNpc then
				GameHelper.onMyGunHitNpc:Fire(npc,hit,actualEndPosition)
			end
		end

		if isSteamWeapon then
			local serverSucceeded, serverEndPosition = GameHelper.CharacterGunFireC2S:InvokeServer(hit, endPos, shotContext and shotContext.ShotToken)
			if serverSucceeded ~= true then return end
			playLocalShot(typeof(serverEndPosition) == "Vector3" and serverEndPosition or endPos)
		else
			playLocalShot(endPos)
			task.spawn(function()
				-- The immediate tracer is prediction; the server recomputes the ray for
				-- authoritative damage and nearby-player visuals.
				GameHelper.CharacterGunFireC2S:InvokeServer(hit, endPos, shotContext and shotContext.ShotToken)
			end)
		end
	end

	local function startFireLoop(context)
		if holdingFire then return end
		holdingFire = true
		heldContext = context
		task.spawn(function()
			while holdingFire and gun.Parent == LocalPlayer.Character do
				tryFireGun(heldContext)
				task.wait(0.03)
			end
		end)
	end
	local function stopFireLoop()
		holdingFire = false
		heldContext = nil
	end
	local function bindNewInput()
		if gun.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
		RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(gun)
		if not RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then return end
		RangedCombatClient.BindFireActions(gun,function(context)
			if context.Trigger == "CenterButton" then
				startFireLoop(context)
			else
				tryFireGun(context)
			end
		end,function(context)
			if context.Trigger == "CenterButton" or context.Trigger == "Cancelled" then
				stopFireLoop()
			end
		end)
	end

	_toolCP:Add(v_reloading.Changed:Connect(function()
		if v_reloading.Value then AudioHelper:PlayEffect("Gun-Reload") end
	end))
	_toolCP:Add(featureSwitch.Changed:Connect(function()
		if not RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then stopFireLoop() end
		bindNewInput()
	end))
	_toolCP:Add(UserInputService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PreferredInput"):Connect(function()
		if not RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then stopFireLoop() end
		bindNewInput()
	end))
	_toolCP:Add(gun.Activated:Connect(function()
		if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then return end
		tryFireGun(nil)
	end))
	bindNewInput()
end)

ToolHelper.onUnequipTool.Event:Connect(function(_,gun:Tool)
	RangedCombatClient.UnbindWeaponCrosshair(gun)
	idleTrack:Stop()
	_toolCP:DisconnectAll()
end)

    if not lamp or not SpotLight then return end
    local v_isLight:BoolValue = lamp:FindFirstChild("isLight")
    if not v_isLight or not v_isLight.Value then return end

    if gameTimeNow >= nextCheckDeerTime then
        nextCheckDeerTime = gameTimeNow + 0.1

        -- 检测是否照到小鹿

        if deerModel then

                GameHelper.DeerStunnedC2S:FireServer()

    end

local TimeValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.TimeValue

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = LocalPlayer.Character
local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local gameController = GameHelper:GetController()
local v_isDaytime = ValueHelper:WaitValue(gameController,TimeValue.isDaytime)
local v_day:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(gameController,TimeValue.day)

math.randomseed(tick())
while true do
    task.wait(25)
    -- 白天不刷
    if v_isDaytime.Value then continue end
    if v_day.Value <= 2 then continue end

    -- 角色死亡，不刷
    if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character) then continue end
    -- 在野猪战场，不刷
    if GameHelper:IsOnCave() then continue end

    local startPos = humanoidRootPart.Position
    -- 在钻石塔里，不刷
    if GameHelper:IsInGemTower(startPos) then continue end
    -- 在营火附近，不刷小怪
    if GameHelper:IsInCampfire(startPos,50) then continue end
    local range = math.random(3,10)
    local x,z = CommonFunc:GetDir2D(math.random(0,359))
    local dir = Vector3.new(x*range,0,z*range)

    -- 检测周围有没有怪追
    local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
    overlapParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy))
    overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
    local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(character:GetPivot().Position,10,overlapParams)
    if #hits > 0 then return end -- 周围有敌人，跳过

    -- 查找横向阻挡
    local spawnPos:Vector3
    local raycastParamsH = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParamsH:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
    raycastParamsH:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy))
    local hitResultH:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(startPos,dir,raycastParamsH)
    if hitResultH then
        spawnPos = hitResultH.Position
    else
        spawnPos = startPos + dir
    end
    local zoneLv = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(startPos))
    GameHelper.SpawnNightEnemyC2S:FireServer(spawnPos,zoneLv)
end"},{"id":585,"text":"local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

    if door and (not GameHelper:GetDoorEnable(door) or GameHelper:GetDoorOpen(door)) then
        door = nil

	if door and GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) then
		GameHelper.OpenDoorC2S:FireServer(door)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	if v_dragItem.Value or not GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) then
		forceItem()
		return
	end

    local door:Model = nil
	
	local inFirstPerson = (camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom and
		(camera.CFrame.Position - camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude < 1.5)

	if inFirstPerson then
		local rayOrigin = camera.CFrame.Position
		local rayDirection = camera.CFrame.LookVector * range
		local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
		raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character}
		raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

		local result:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(rayOrigin, rayDirection, raycastParams)

		if result then
            door = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(result.Instance,GameEnum.Tag.GameDoor)
		end
	else
		local mouseTarget = mouse.Target
		if mouseTarget then
			local distance = (mouseTarget.Position - LocalPlayer.Character:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude
			if distance <= range then
                door = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(mouseTarget,GameEnum.Tag.GameDoor)
			end
		end
	end

    forceItem(door)
end)"},{"id":586,"text":"local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local function restoreSteamHeatHighlight()
	if _suppressedSteamHighlight then
		if _suppressedSteamHighlightParent and _suppressedSteamHighlightParent.Parent then
			_suppressedSteamHighlight.Parent = _suppressedSteamHighlightParent
			_suppressedSteamHighlight.Enabled = _suppressedSteamHighlightEnabled == true
		else
			_suppressedSteamHighlight:Destroy()
		end
	end
	_suppressedSteamTarget = nil
	_suppressedSteamHighlight = nil
	_suppressedSteamHighlightParent = nil
	_suppressedSteamHighlightEnabled = nil
end

	if target == _suppressedSteamTarget then return end
	restoreSteamHeatHighlight()
	if not target then return end

	local itemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(target)
	if not itemLo or (itemLo.id ~= 614 and itemLo.id ~= 615) then return end
	local heatHighlight = target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Highlight", true)
	if not heatHighlight then return end

	_suppressedSteamTarget = target
	_suppressedSteamHighlight = heatHighlight
	_suppressedSteamHighlightParent = heatHighlight.Parent
	_suppressedSteamHighlightEnabled = heatHighlight.Enabled
	heatHighlight.Enabled = false
	heatHighlight.Parent = script
end

	updateSteamHeatHighlightSuppression(target)

		local id = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(target,DragItemValue.id)
		local t_desc:TextLabel = BillboardGui:WaitForChild("t_desc")
		local t_name:TextLabel = BillboardGui:WaitForChild("t_name")
		if ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(target) then
			local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(id)
			local name = resLo.ItemName

			local owner:Player = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(target,DragItemValue.owner)
			if owner then
				name = string.format("%s :to %s",name,owner.DisplayName)
			end
			t_desc.Text = resLo.desc or ""
			t_name.Text = name
			UIItemDesc:PivotTo(CFrame.new(target:GetPivot().Position))
		elseif CraftItemHelper:IsCraftTool(target) then
			local craftLo = CraftItemHelper:GetLo(id)
			t_desc.Text = ""
			t_name.Text = craftLo.ItemName
			UIItemDesc:PivotTo(CFrame.new(target:GetPivot().Position))
		end
	else
		UIItemDesc:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0,-500,0))

	_hightlight.Enabled = target ~= nil

	InteractiveHelper:SetFocusTarget(target)

local character:Model = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()

local _config = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Jobs"):WaitForChild("无名客")

local v_hitAddEnergy3 = _config:WaitForChild("3级命中充能")
local v_maxEnergy = _config:WaitForChild("最大充能")

-- 开火
local fireTrack:AnimationTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(character,82124648755414)

fireTrack.Looped = false
fireTrack:Stop()

local targetGUIFolder:Folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("TargetGUIFolder")
if targetGUIFolder then
    targetGUIFolder:ClearAllChildren()
else
    targetGUIFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    targetGUIFolder.Name = "TargetGUIFolder"
    targetGUIFolder.Parent = workspace
end

local _curGun:Tool = nil

-- 刷新目标
local targets:{Model} = {}
function updateTargets()
	local range = v_range.Value
	if LocalPlayer:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.StrangerV2) then
		-- 2级技能，增加范围
		range *= 1.5
	end
	targets = GameHelper:NPCCollect(character:GetPivot().Position,range)
end

-- 刷新目标UI
function refreshTargetGUI()
	local guis:{BillboardGui} = targetGUIFolder:GetChildren()
	local num = math.max(#targets,#guis)
	for i=1,num do
		local target = targets[i]
		local gui = guis[i]
		if not gui then
			local newGui = TargetGUIPrefab:Clone()
			newGui.Parent = targetGUIFolder
			gui = newGui
		end
		gui.Enabled = target ~= nil
		gui.Adornee = target and (target:FindFirstChild("Head") or target) or nil
	end
end

ToolHelper.onEquipTool.Event:Connect(function(_,gun:Tool)
    if gun and gun:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gun) then
        _curGun = gun
    end
end)

ToolHelper.onUnequipTool.Event:Connect(function()
    fireTrack:Stop()
    _curGun = nil
	targetGUIFolder:ClearAllChildren()
    readyGui.Enabled = false
end)

GameHelper.onMyGunHitNpc.Event:Connect(function(npc:Model,hit:BasePart,endPos:Vector3)
	if v_energy.Value < v_maxEnergy.Value then
        if not _curGun then return end
		
		local add = 1
		if LocalPlayer:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.StrangerV3) then
			-- 3级技能，增加充能
			add = v_hitAddEnergy3.Value
		else
			add = v_hitAddEnergy.Value
		end
		v_energy.Value += add
		if v_energy.Value >= v_maxEnergy.Value then
			v_energy.Value = v_maxEnergy.Value
			updateTargets()
			refreshTargetGUI()
		end
	elseif v_energy.Value >= v_maxEnergy.Value then
		-- 爆这些目标的头
		--print("TODO 触发麦克雷")
        if not _curGun then return end

		local hitTargets = targets
		v_energy.Value = 0
		targets = {}
		refreshTargetGUI()
		task.wait(0.1)
		for i=1,#hitTargets do
            -- 检测手中是否有枪
            if not _curGun then break end
			local target = hitTargets[i]
			if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(target) then continue end
			local head:Part = target:FindFirstChild("Head") or target.PrimaryPart
			local endPos = head.Position
			GameHelper.TriggerSkillC2S:FireServer(target,endPos)
			fireTrack:Play()
			task.spawn(function()
				GameHelper:PlayRegularBulletStyle(_curGun,endPos)
			end)
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end
end)

-- 循环刷新目标
while task.wait(0.5) do
	if not _curGun then continue end
	if v_energy.Value >= v_maxEnergy.Value then
		updateTargets()
		refreshTargetGUI()
        readyGui.Enabled = true
    else
        readyGui.Enabled = false
	end
